chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 481: Mother Queen Possession & Patriarch Subhuti's Arrival
chapter_meta_description: A million horned warriors sacrifice themselves to form three terrifying Mother Queen clones. The seven Empyrean Gods are stalemated—until Ji Ning's master arrives.
og_title: Mother Queen Possession: The Broken Horn World's Ultimate Trump Card
og_description: A million souls burn as fuel for three monstrous clones. The Empyrean Gods can't break free. Then, a grey-white vortex opens.
twitter_title: The Master is Here! Subhuti Steps In
twitter_description: Million-strong army sacrificed, three god-tier clones holding the line—then a certain white-haired Daoist crashes the party.

lore_anchors.definition: The ultimate weapon of the Broken Horn World, where the entire population is created to be willingly sacrificed, their life force merging to form powerful clones of the Mother Queen.
An ancient divine formation that allows seven Empyrean Gods to merge their power into a single, towering combatant with dramatically increased combat power.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a Celestial Immortal, achieved after successfully surviving the Heavenly Tribulation.
The dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the Chaosverse, devoid of Dao resonance and hostile to cultivators.
The elite military force of the Broken Horn World; its First Army consists of a million horned warriors under one General and eight hundred commanders.
A cultivator who has fully mastered a Grand Dao, representing one of the highest power ceilings within the Three Realms.
A hostile, alien world that survived the ancient war against the Three Realms, ruled by a collective of Mother Queens.
